coverage.label: Superior vena cava
coverage.note: Returns blood from the upper body to the right atrium.

coverage.label: Inferior vena cava
coverage.note: Returns blood from the lower body to the right atrium.

coverage.label: Right atrium
coverage.note: Receives systemic venous blood before the tricuspid valve.

coverage.label: Tricuspid valve
coverage.note: Separates right atrium and right ventricle; limits backward flow during ventricular contraction.

coverage.label: Right ventricle
coverage.note: Pumps blood through its outflow region and pulmonary valve toward the lungs.

coverage.label: Conus arteriosus
coverage.note: No adequate class definition located. ASPT guide topic retained with a labeled supplemental anatomy explanation.

coverage.label: Pulmonary valve
coverage.note: Semilunar valve between the right ventricular outflow and pulmonary trunk.

coverage.label: Pulmonary trunk
coverage.note: The common vessel leaving the right ventricle before it branches toward the lungs.

coverage.label: Left pulmonary artery
coverage.note: Carries blood toward the left lung; oxygen-poor in normal adult circulation.

coverage.label: Left pulmonary veins
coverage.note: Return oxygen-rich blood from the left lung to the left atrium.

coverage.label: Left atrium
coverage.note: Receives pulmonary venous blood before the mitral valve.

coverage.label: Mitral valve
coverage.note: The left AV/bicuspid valve between the left atrium and ventricle.

coverage.label: Left ventricle
coverage.note: Pumps into the aorta and has the thick systemic-pumping muscle wall.

coverage.label: Aortic valve
coverage.note: Semilunar valve between left ventricle and aorta.

coverage.label: Ascending aorta
coverage.note: The initial upward part of the aorta after the aortic valve.

coverage.label: Arch of aorta
coverage.note: The curved continuation of the ascending aorta.

coverage.label: Interatrial septum
coverage.note: Separates the right and left atria.

coverage.label: Interventricular septum
coverage.note: Separates the right and left ventricles.

coverage.label: Papillary muscle
coverage.note: Ventricular muscle that tensions the chordae tendineae.

coverage.label: Chordae tendineae
coverage.note: Cords between AV valve cusps and papillary muscles; not semilunar valve supports.

coverage.label: Trabeculae carneae
coverage.note: No adequate class definition located. ASPT guide topic retained with a labeled supplemental anatomy explanation.

g02.title: ASPT guide: precordial placement

g03.title: ASPT guide: waveform
g03.cue: Identify P, Q, R, S and T in each sequence. No distinct U is reliably visible. Calibration is not stated.

s01.title: Class: paper scale
s01.cue: Read time across and voltage vertically; calculations depend on speed and gain.

s02.title: Class: interference comparison 1
s02.cue: Compare major baseline disturbance above with finer noise below. Source labels describe demonstrated causes; the appearance alone is not a unique diagnosis.

s03.title: Class: interference comparison 2
s03.cue: Compare tremor-associated noise with patient-movement distortion. Assess the patient and verify electrode contact.
